create_semantic_segmentation_model: create an EfficientViTForSemanticSegmentation model for pixel-level classification with sigmoid output logits
build_layout_segmentation_model: build an EfficientViTForSemanticLayoutSegmentation model for layout-aware semantic segmentation tasks
run_encoder_decoder_forward: run the EfficientViT encoder-decoder forward pass to produce segmentation logits from pixel values
